description: This is a Python source file implementing a multilingual voice assistant bot with language switching capabilities, utilizing various speech and language processing services, and defining classes, functions, and event handlers for the bot's operation.

classes.name: SwitchLanguage
classes.description: A class extending ParallelPipeline that manages language switching between English and Spanish, providing filters and a method to switch languages dynamically.

methods.name: switch_language
methods.description: Asynchronously switches the current language based on user input and sends a confirmation message.

methods.name: english_filter
methods.description: Asynchronous filter method that returns true if the current language is English.

methods.name: spanish_filter
methods.description: Asynchronous filter method that returns true if the current language is Spanish.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the voice assistant bot with specified transport and runner arguments, including event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point function that initializes the transport and starts the bot.
